Topic.label: Views from Different Directions and Nets of Solid Figures

Question:
How many common forms of a cube's net are there? How many squares does each net contain? (Answer in order, separated by a comma.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_051_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: There are 11 nets of a cube in total (6 of type 1-4-1, 3 of type 2-3-1, 1 of type 2-2-2, and 1 of type 3-3). Each consists of 6 identical squares.
